_about: Make-row category 'Zoning' (Core/Tool/Shelf.cs): the looks of an area's buildings (Core/Layers/Types/Zoning/PolishLookLayer). Each type is a look (its option rows are every setting of the neighbourhood polish, its styles Compact / Standard / Sprawling and the player's own); Build polishes the buildings in the area. The City window (header button) sets each zone type's look for new buildings and polishes or unpolishes the whole city.
name: Zoning
